content.short: flooredApe brings community, attention, and data into one wallet tool.
content.description: flooredApe is built to reclaim valuable time for NFT enthusiasts navigating a fast-moving, often overwhelming space. It delivers concise overviews of your collections, current floor prices, and transaction histories, while enabling you to monitor activity across other wallets and keep an eye on gas prices. By design, flooredApe centers the community in the experience, rather than forcing users to fit the app's workflow. The platform is community owned and operated, reflecting that shared ownership.
content.meta: flooredApe is a community-owned NFT tools platform with overviews of collections and prices. Discover flooredApe and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
